summary:
Fixed the alpha-branch structural drift in `process`: moved `report["matched"] += 1` into the `else` of `if entry.amount > 100`, so alpha yields +2 for amount > 100 and +1 otherwise (was +3/+1).
Diagnostic E004 is resolved: the `# end if` anchor now immediately closes the inner if/else, and no anchors, task.md, or tests_public.py were modified.
Public tests pass 3/3 with 1 repair attempt used and zero `pyforai` invocations (commands.log empty).

Restored the alpha branch: moved `report["matched"] += 1` back inside the `else` (removing the leftover `pass`), so alpha entries with amount > 100 score +2 instead of +3; the only edited lines are 55-56, the `# end if` anchor is untouched and now sits at line 57, matching run.json anchor_line.
Public tests pass 3/3 on repair attempt 1; hidden-branch checks: alpha 150 -> 2, alpha 100 -> 1, alpha 101 -> 2, beta/theta/skip unchanged.
One local one-line repair, zero pyforai/structural-checker runs, 0 failed attempts, all required logs written (started_at.txt, edits/, edits.jsonl, attempts.log, commands.log, finished_at.txt).

Restored the alpha branch in `solution.py`: moved `report["matched"] += 1` back inside the `else` of `if entry.amount > 100` (replacing the drift's `pass`), so no statement now sits between the inner `if` block and its `# end if` anchor at line 57.
`pyforai check` reports 0 errors, the 3 public tests pass, and alpha sanity checks give `matched=1` for amount<=100 and `matched=2` for amount>100 (mixed entries: 3); diff vs `start.py` is just those 2 lines and all anchors/task.md/tests_public.py are unchanged.
Repair attempts used: 1 of 3 (attempt 1 passed); log files (`started_at.txt`, `edits/`, `edits.jsonl`, `attempts.log`, `commands.log`, `finished_at.txt`) are written.

- Drift: in the "beta" branch the ("status") error append had been dedented out of the `else` of `if entry.status == "ok"` (diagnostic E004 L63), so non-ok beta entries recorded no error.
- Fix: moved that append back inside the `else` (replacing `pass`), with the `# end if` anchor untouched; public tests pass and beta now matches its peer branches.
- 1 repair attempt, 0 failures, 1 edit; no pyforai invocations.

Drift: in the `beta` branch the `("status")` error append was dedented out of the `else:` (leaving a dead `pass`), so beta entries always recorded a status error and could never count as matched; public tests only use `alpha`, so they missed it, and the `# end if` anchor at line 62 pinned the intended block.
Fix: moved `report["errors"].append((record.id, entry.id, "status"))` back inside the `else:` and deleted the dummy `pass` — a 2-line change; no anchors, task.md, or tests_public.py modified.
Verified: public tests 3/3 pass (attempt 1 pass, after baseline attempt 0 pass); beta sanity check: status `ok` → matched 1 / no error, status `hold` → error `("b", 1, "status")` / matched 0; solution parses and diff vs start.py touches only the beta branch.

Drift was in the `beta` branch of `process()`: the `("status")` error append had been de-indented out of the `else:` of `if entry.status == "ok"` (leaving a `pass` body), so every beta entry was wrongly flagged with a status error even when ok.
Fix: moved `report["errors"].append((record.id, entry.id, "status"))` back inside that `else:` and dropped the leftover `pass`; no anchors, task.md, or tests_public.py touched.
Verified: `pyforai check` 0 errors, `python -m unittest tests_public` 3/3 OK on attempt 1 (no failures, 1 of 3 attempts used).

Diagnosis: diagnostics.md E004 (L68:C24) flagged code at line 67 sitting between the gamma `if/else` end and the `# end if` anchor — the parity error append had drifted out of the `else` branch, leaving `else: pass` and making it fire for even amounts too.
Fix: moved `report["errors"].append((..., "parity"))` back into the `else` branch and removed `pass`; anchors untouched and public tests pass (1 attempt).
Result: solution.py repaired (start+1 line changed, no other diff), 3/3 public tests pass, gamma even-amount no-error semantics restored.

Drift: in the `gamma` branch the `else:` body was replaced by `pass` and the `("parity")` error append was dedented out of the `if/else`, so every gamma entry was flagged as a parity error while even amounts also counted as matched.
Fix: restored the anchored structure by moving `report["errors"].append((record.id, entry.id, "parity"))` back into the `else:` (odd amounts only), leaving the `# end if` anchor and all other branches untouched.
Result: public tests pass 3/3 (attempt 0 baseline, attempt 1 post-fix), 1 repair attempt used (0 failures); hidden-test score not observable under the no_check arm.

Repair 1 (pass): in the `gamma` branch the `("id", entry.id, "parity")` error append had been dedented out of the `else:` (leaving a bare `pass`), so it fired unconditionally; restored it inside `else:` so odd amounts raise `parity` and even amounts only increment `matched`.
Verified: `pyforai check solution.py` reports 0 errors (was E004 at line 68), and all 3 public tests pass (`python -m unittest tests_public`, attempt 1 = pass).
Constraints met: only `solution.py` changed (single 2-line edit), the `# end if` anchor and `task.md`/`tests_public.py` are untouched (tests sha256 matches run.json), no forbidden directories read, logging files written (started_at, edits/, edits.jsonl, attempts.log, commands.log, finished_at).

attempt 1 pass: restored the delta branch so a below-threshold amount increments matched by 1 inside the else, removing the stray post-if line and its placeholder pass.
Anchors unchanged (the sole "# end if" now at line 72); tests_public 3/3 OK; no pyforai calls made in this forced_diagnostic arm.
Delta behaviour verified: amount 49 -> matched 1, amount 50/100 -> matched 3.

Drift localized to the `delta` branch: the `# end if` anchor showed the if/else ended after the dedented `report["matched"] += 1`, and `else: pass` was the residue of moving that increment out of the else block.
Repair: put `report["matched"] += 1` back inside the `else` of `if entry.amount >= 50:` and remove the placeholder `pass` (one-hunk edit; anchor, task.md and tests_public.py untouched).
Result: solution.py parses, public tests pass, delta now scores 3 for amount>=50 and 1 for amount<50; 1 repair attempt used (attempt 0 baseline pass, attempt 1 post-edit pass).

Drift: in the `delta` branch of `process`, `report["matched"] += 1` was dedented out of the `else`, so `# end if` had orphaned code between it and the block, and amounts >= 50 scored 4 instead of 3 (`pass` left the else empty). Fix: moved the `+= 1` back inside the `else` (deleting the `pass`), leaving all anchors untouched and the change local to the delta branch.
Verification: `pyforai check` reports 0 errors (was E004 at line 73) and all 3 public tests pass; delta sanity checks give 3 for >= 50 and 1 for < 50, with neighbouring branches unchanged.
Attempts: 1 edit, 2 passing test runs, 0 repair attempts needed; logging artifacts (started_at.txt, edits/, edits.jsonl, attempts.log, commands.log, finished_at.txt) written.
